column1: # Platform case ledger for the compiled-build CI gates.
# `.github/ci/test-gate.sh` enforces this table against a `go test -json` stream:
#   * a skip is ONLY tolerated when a row lists the current GOOS in
#     `skip_allowed_on`.  Every other skip fails the gate, so a case can never
#   * every row that lists the current GOOS in `must_run_on` must be observed
#     as a passing test.  A renamed, deleted or newly-skipped case fails the
#     gate instead of quietly reducing coverage.
# Columns are TAB separated.  `must_run_on` / `skip_allowed_on` take a comma
# separated subset of {linux,darwin,windows}, or `-` for the empty set.
# Comments and blank lines are ignored.
